title: Upgrade Interest and Future Feature Requests
summary: Reviews center on satisfaction with current upgrades and on forward-looking comments about desired future options or upgrade eligibility, especially suspension-related features.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle’s upgrades compared with an earlier model and mention selected options such as suspension, leather, and adjustable seats.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention future upgrades, possible eligibility for listed upgrades, and interest in options like air suspension without a clear evaluative stance.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are brief or forward-looking and do not provide enough detail for a clear sentiment classification.
This topic mixes current upgrade satisfaction, upgrade eligibility questions, and future feature requests, so the theme is only loosely coherent.
The examples are limited to one model and the supplied stratified sample, so they do not show broader representativeness.
